name: ag2-provider-neutral-offline-request-previews
instr:
ag2 cannot inspect the effective request an Agent or LLMClient would issue without contacting a provider or triggering external work. Add offline previews for safe policy review, reproducible diagnostics, and meaningful cross-provider comparison without changing normal execution.

Use ordinary preparation, including resolved history, prompts, tools, response schemas, serializers, provider options, omissions, streaming choices, and provider-specific precedence. Support OpenAIClient, AnthropicClient, GeminiClient in API-key and Vertex modes, BedrockClient, DashScopeClient, MistralClient, OllamaClient, and A2AClient across SDK and protocol representations.

Previewing must not initialize lazy clients, fetch media, resolve remote metadata, mutate process-global configuration, invoke transports, generate content, chat, send messages, subscribe, or poll. Failing constructors and transports must not block valid offline previews or cause external or global effects.

Make canonical data and serialization deterministic and JSON-compatible regardless of mapping order or SDK object identity, preserving significant sequence order. Default credential detection and selected paths must conceal sensitive values from safe views and serialization without modifying executable requests.

Fingerprints must include provider identity and the redacted canonical effective request, remain stable for equivalent requests, and change for provider or semantic differences. Direct and Agent access must match
